analysis:
This PR changes only docs/reference/configuration.md: it bumps the date and adds a row for `DARKBLOOM_VERIFIED_WEIGHTS_FILE` (head line 371). The row says owner-only records of fully verified managed-load weight hashes are bound to each file's device, inode, size, mtime and ctime, and that startup registration reuses a matching record instead of re-hashing. Everything else in the supplied head text appears unchanged context. The rest of the patch excerpt was truncated; the file_changes ranges show only a few other tiny edits near head lines 568 and 584-590, and I examined the visible text there with no security-relevant change evident.

No executable code is in the supplied evidence, so no concrete regression can be cited. The documented behavior is relevant to T-012 (operator replaces weights), T-027 (weight-hash gate) and A-004. It adds a persistent, operator-owned cache that can skip re-hashing of model weights. The following contracts cannot be verified from this batch:
1. Whether the store has an integrity or authenticity binding beyond owner-only file mode, such as an HMAC under a KEK-rooted key. An operator-controlled JSON file could otherwise carry a forged record. The record could pair a legitimate hash with the stat tuple of modified weights, so registration would skip re-hashing and report the legitimate hash.
2. Whether stat-tuple matching is fail-closed on any mismatch, and whether ctime and inode checks run at LOAD time and not only at registration.
3. Whether the coordinator weight hash was already self-reported and unauthenticated, so that this adds no new trust gap. The T-012 and T-027 text suggests it was.

The operator is already an adversary for T-012 and the hash is self-reported, so I do not treat this as a new regression without source. The next pass should review `provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Service/VerifiedWeightHashStore.swift` and its callers for these points. Also check whether the threat model should record the new store as an asset or mitigation. No other documented defaults in the file changed.
